sections.section_title: Clinical Presentation and Complex Historical Context
sections.description: This section introduces the patient's demographic profile, presenting symptoms, and the intricate chronological history leading up to the third intervention. It establishes the 'why' behind the case by detailing the progression from initial TAVI to valve-in-valve procedures and the intervening complication of prosthetic valve endocarditis (PVE). The goal is to help learners appreciate the cumulative burden of comorbidities and previous interventions that define this high-risk scenario.
subtopics: Demographics and Initial Presentation: Dyspnea, angina-like sensations, and heart failure symptoms
Comorbidity Profile: Coronary artery disease, pacemaker dependence, COPD, and diabetes
Chronology of Interventions: Timeline of the 2014 Lotus TAVI, 2022 Evolut TAV-in-TAV, and vascular complications
The Interlude of Infective Endocarditis: Diagnosis of Enterococcus faecalis PVE in 2022 and antimicrobial management
Pre-Reintervention Assessment: Hemodynamic decline in 2024 despite prior treatment

sections.section_title: Pathophysiology of Sequential Structural Valve Deterioration
sections.description: Moving beyond simple summary, this section explains the underlying biological and mechanical mechanisms causing valve failure in a 'TAV-in-TAV-in-TAV' setting. It differentiates between standard structural valve deterioration (SVD), hemodynamic consequences of stacking multiple stent frames (reduced effective orifice area), and the specific impact of prior infection on leaflet integrity. This provides the theoretical foundation for why these cases are uniquely challenging compared to standard re-do surgeries.
subtopics: Mechanisms of Transcatheter Valve Failure: Leaflet fibrosis, calcification, and thrombosis over time
Hemodynamics of Stacked Frames: Understanding 'stacking effect,' particle-induced obstruction risks, and prosthesis-patient mismatch (PPM)

-5]: Impact of Prior Endocarditis on Prosthetic Integrity: How infection alters tissue quality and healing potential
